newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PSE returns YSE to main market.
newsitem.headline: Czech PSE returns YSE to main market.

text.p: The listing committee of the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) has agreed to list the Czech holding company YSE a.s. on the bourse's main market, a member of the committee told Reuters on Monday.

"YSE was accepted... with this it must fulfil the same (information) responsibilities as an investment fund, (meaning) showing the contents of its portfolio and net assets per share," said PSE committee member Pavla Vodstrcilova.
Shares of YSE, which was converted into a holding company from its status as an investment fund last year and then lost its main market listing, have since been trading on the bourse's free market.
It will regain the main market listing after it pays a listing fee and publishes an announcement of the listing with the required information.
